blueprint_section: P2 Embedding residual / G50 / RAG lifecycle
objective: Post-drift new-generation builds are triggered by the migration tool, not ad-hoc rebuild calls.

api.apply_migration(plan, apply_metadata=?,: executes a MigrationPlan phase-by-phase (DETECT/PLAN -> APPLY_METADATA -> BUILD_VECTOR_GENERATION -> VALIDATE -> ACTIVATE)

implementation.drift_entry_point: PipelineRecoveryMixin.migrate_schema(generation_manager, current=..., target=..., apply_metadata=?, validate=?, benchmark_fn=?) — plans the migration and wires BUILD_VECTOR_GENERATION to rebuild_canonical (PG-authority rebuild -> validate -> benchmark -> atomic promote)
fail_closed: metadata axis changed but no apply_metadata executor -> blocked 'metadata-migration-executor-missing', nothing mutated
vector axis changed but no builder -> blocked 'vector-generation-builder-missing'
rebuild report incomplete (no VALIDATE+ACTIVATE in steps_completed) -> blocked 'vector-generation-build-incomplete', ACTIVATE never marked
executor raises -> blocked '<phase>-failed:<err>' and the sequence stops
validate callable returning falsy -> blocked 'validation-failed', ACTIVATE never reached

new_cases: metadata-only plan executed via injected executor
missing metadata executor -> blocked, ACTIVATE never reached
vector plan -> governed build via rebuild_canonical, all phases completed
failing metadata executor stops sequence before vector phase
validator gate rejects -> ACTIVATE never reached
migrate_schema drift entry -> plans + triggers governed vector build

residual: call-site wiring: production trigger for migrate_schema on _generation_rebuild_required (currently the flag only blocks canonical indexing until an operator/governed flow invokes the migration tool)
metadata-axis apply_metadata executor for PG schema migrations (none exist yet — blocked by design until supplied)
